message.content: {"4": {"original": "I hope nobody stops editing Wikipedia because of the blackout.", "rephrased": "The Wikimedia Foundation hopes that the 24-hour Wikipedia blackout, a protest against U.S. anti-piracy laws, will not cause permanent damage to the community by driving away editors who might otherwise contribute to the encyclopedia.", "summary": "The Foundation hopes the anti-piracy protest will not permanently drive away Wikipedia editors."}, "5": {"original": "The community decision-making process was a good one, with over 1,800,000+1,800,", "rephrased": "The Wikimedia Foundation views the internal community decision-making process regarding the anti-piracy protest as highly successful, citing record participation levels and overwhelming consensus in favor of taking action.", "summary": "The Foundation views the community's decision-making process for the protest as highly successful."}, "6": {"original": "The Foundation is not concerned that only English Wikipedia is enacting the", "rephrased": "The Wikimedia Foundation is not concerned that only the English version of Wikipedia is enacting the anti-piracy blackout, noting that other language projects have different circumstances that may justify different types of responses or no action at all.", "summary": "The Foundation is not concerned that only the English Wikipedia is enacting the blackout."}, "7": {"original": "Each project and language has different circumstances justifying different", "rephrased": "The Wikimedia Foundation believes that each Wikipedia project and language version has unique circumstances that may justify different types of advocacy actions or no action, rejecting the idea that there is a single correct approach for all projects.", "summary": "The Foundation believes each project has unique circumstances justifying different advocacy actions."}}
